VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LIFE_CALCULATION.title: Cough
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LIFE_CALCULATION.descrip: Before the card's listed effects resolve, pay the stated amount as unblockable, unpowered HP loss. Margin is consumed first to offset this payment 1:1. The actual cost has a minimum of 0. The card cannot be played if the remaining payment would leave you below 1 HP.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_MARGIN.title: Margin
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_MARGIN.description: Each point is automatically consumed to offset 1 point of Cough. Margin does not prevent other HP loss and has no stacking cap.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DIMENSION_UP.title: Dimension Up
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DIMENSION_UP.description: Permanently increase Max HP by the stated amount and increase current HP by the same amount. This includes temporarily generated cards and copied cards; every resolution is treated equally, with no growth cap.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DRAIN.title: Drain
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_DRAIN.description: After an Attack card finishes dealing all damage, total the actual HP lost by enemies, multiply by its total Drain rate, round up once, and heal that amount. Card and global rates add in percentage points, may exceed 100%, and healing has no cap. Blocked damage, overkill, self-damage, Thorns, and non-Attack damage do not count.
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LETHAL.title: Lethal
VIVHITE_KEYWORD_LETHAL.description: Triggers when this card directly kills a target.
